source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fallback catches OSError and assigns lines=[] before the existing line-count warning/return. The same landing removes comm's obsolete source-stamp generator and Make override. This prevents an undefined local list on that caught path; it is not complete corrupt-input validation or proof of upstream generated stamps. The exact earlier accepted fallback proof is reused with its original time.
title: Unreadable sourcestamp input reaches the corrupt-file guard with a defined empty list
